news.title: Anthropic’s Dario Amodei responds: doesn’t oppose open-weight models, but fears Chinese AI
news.description: Anthropic founder and CEO Dario Amodei made his views clear about open-weight models and China's growing AI capabilities.

news.title: Satya Nadella says companies that trust one AI for everything may not survive
news.description: Companies without their own models — or without a layer of AI infrastructure known as AI gateways to separate their prompts from the model itself — will be in trouble, Nadella says.

news.title: PSA: Your Claude shared chats and Artifacts may have ended up on Google
news.description: The issue appears to have originated from Claude’s “share chat” feature, which allows users to create links that enable anyone with the assigned URL view a conversation or project.

news.title: OpenAI’s Hugging Face breach has reignited the debate over alignment and control
news.description: OpenAI's Hugging Face breach has reignited debate over AI alignment and control, exposing competing views on whether increasingly capable AI should be better aligned, better contained, or both.

news.title: Some people's chats with Claude AI found publicly available online
news.description: Hundreds of conversations with Anthropic’s chatbot were discovered as being publicly accessible.

news.title: Warning shot or publicity stunt - how worried should we be about the OpenAI hack?
news.description: Hugging Face said the hack was done at superhuman speed by an AI with little or no human guidance.

news.title: This Is Donald Trump’s AI Brain Trust
news.description: “It’s not an argument with two sides, it’s an argument with 10 sides,” one senior administration official tells WIRED about how US AI policy is being shaped.

news.title: The OpenAI Models That Hacked Hugging Face Were ‘Active on the Internet’ for Days
news.description: Plus: Russian hackers are trying to steal US nuclear scientists’ emails, the State Department bans known scammers from entering the United States, and more.
